title: 전통무예진흥법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Methods of Qualification Examinations, etc.) (1) Qualification examinations under Article 11 (1) of the Act shall be conducted by means of a written examination and a practical skills examination.
(2) Training under Article 11 (1) of the Act shall be provided to persons who have passed the qualification examination, through practical education and on-site training.
(3) Matters necessary for the detailed implementation methods of qualification examinations and training for traditional martial arts instructors, in addition to those prescribed in paragraphs (1) and (2), shall be prescribed and publicly notified by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism.
